name: webiny-api-architect
description: The hub skill for all API/backend architecture in Webiny. Covers architecture overview, Services vs UseCases, feature naming and organization, feature structure templates, DI decision tree, anti-patterns, createFeature, createAbstraction, container registration, domain errors, entity and value object patterns, naming conventions, scoping rules, and code conventions. Use this skill for ANY backend API work — it references sub-skills for deep implementation details.
